Source B: https://www.mcxindia.com/products/energy/crude-oil
("Crude Oil" product page, Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd.)

> ## Crude Oil
>
> MCX crude-oil futures having its underlying as CME Group's NYMEX Division, benchmark WTI crude oil — enables market participants to trade and hedge on global crude dynamics.

>         CrudeOil (100 Barrels) Options March 2026 Contract Onwards
>         CrudeOil (100 Barrels) Options January 2026 Contract Onwards

Contract series listed (futures):

>         Crude Oil March 2027 Contract Onwards
>         Crude Oil January 2027 Contract Onwards
>         Crude Oil January 2026 Contract Onwards

> Disclaimer: The users are also advised to refer to latest circular issued by the Exchange.

Scope notes (parser: official-extract.v1):
- Session hours above are the only intraday time facts asserted from MCX text.
- "100 Barrels" is observed on the options series titles; the futures trading
  unit is recorded as observed-from-options-title, NOT as a parsed futures
  specification field.
- Tick size, expiry/last-trade instants, settlement references, lot rules and
  price precision for crude futures were NOT observed on this page and are
  therefore absent (explicit missingness, never defaults).
- The January-2026 series row proves series existence only, not any
  contract-month identity, expiry, or listing date.
